Maya (People Ops): quick Q from Tom's team 1: promo effective 2026-03-01 but comp change hit system 2026-03-18 after payroll cutoff. manager wants to know if net pay can be adjusted vs gross backpay?
Tom (Eng Manager): we ran numbers and tax withholding looks wonky on the preview. can payroll do net-topup instead of gross retro?
Eli (Manager): i've seen companies do a one-time net payment to avoid tax recalcs, but that creates mismatch in records. what's Redwood policy?
Sam (Finance): policy: we always do gross retro to keep tax reporting correct. net-topups are only allowed in exceptional cases and require tax team signoff + exec approval.
Maya (People Ops): practical steps: 1) submit off-cycle payroll ticket with gross backpay calc 2) attach manager approval + promo evidence 3) if you want net-topup, note justification and we'll route to tax for review.
Tom (Eng Manager): understood. any template for the calc to avoid back-and-forth?
Maya (People Ops): paste quick fields: Employee name, ID, effective date, old base, new base, gross backpay amount, pay period breakdown, manager approval link. include monthly PR numbers if partial months.
PayrollBot: Reminder: payroll cutoff is EOM 18:00 UTC; off-cycle processing can take 5-10 business days pending approvals.
Tom (Eng Manager): thanks. i'll open ticket with gross retro and note the net-topup request for tax review. will share ticket link here when submitted. :thumbsup:
